description: Extract structured data from receipts, invoices, and financial documents. Uses a dual-model pipeline (Mistral OCR + Kimi K3) for high-accuracy extraction. Returns JSON with merchant, date, line items, totals, tax, currency, and expense category. Handles crumpled receipts, faded text, and multi-page invoices. 25 sats/page. Pay per request with Bitcoin Lightning — no API key or signup needed. Requires create_payment with toolName='extract_receipt'.

documentBase64.description: Base64 encoded receipt/invoice image or PDF. NOTE: any text-bearing document is accepted — a non-receipt returns best-guess (possibly fabricated) merchant/total/line-item JSON with no error. Confirm the input really is a receipt before trusting the fields.

name: extract_receipt
